items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I would play with guys around there. Pete Peterson and Wendell, Bill Swindell

ctx.x: Yeah so we were all—See, I was stationed to the Army Chemical Center last in Edgewood Maryland and I would come in there and do my little thing and go back out to Edgewood and I would play with guys around there. Pete Peterson and Wendell, Bill Swindell and a little piano player that was married to the little piano player. What’s his name?
